name: Synthesize When All Gathers Complete
description: Fires on the parent coordinator loop entity when the gather.completed_child counter has accumulated as many triples as the source subtopics list. Join half of the ADR-046 Phase 1 fan-out pattern: each investigator completion stamps a triple via rule 02; rule 03 matches via length_eq once the count equals the expected. Expected count is resolved dynamically from $entity.triple.coordinator.decision.subtopics.length (#149) so the pack works for any decomposer fan-out width (N=1 degenerate-serial, N=4 typical, N=10 deep) without per-width forking. The substitution stringifies the integer; length_eq's coerceToInt handles the string-encoded form transparently. The synthesizer receives the sibling loop IDs inlined into its prompt via $entity.triple.gather.completed_child.triples (ADR-048 PR 4) — no graph-query tool needed, persona prose teaches the JSON parse pattern. (publish_agent.properties → TaskMessage.Metadata → ToolCall.Metadata is now available as of gh#354 for threading domain context to a spawned agent's tools; this pack keeps the inlined-prompt form because the synthesizer parses the IDs directly out of the prompt rather than from a tool's metadata.)

on_enter.subject: agent.task.synthesis
on_enter.prompt: All investigators have reported. The sibling investigator loop IDs are inlined here as a JSON array: $entity.triple.gather.completed_child.triples — parse it as JSON, then iterate each ID and call read_loop_result on each to fetch that investigator's findings. Produce a structured synthesis with: 1) one-paragraph summary, 2) per-subtopic key findings, 3) confidence assessment, 4) gaps.
